verdict.rationale: Datalab publishes a documented API reference. It covers convert, extract structured data, segment, create document, run document agent, schema generation and an API health endpoint, plus a Python SDK and per-request webhook parameters. Together these let a user drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Datalab provides document intelligence APIs to convert PDFs, spreadsheets, and images into structured, machine-readable outputs.
Convert a PDF, image, or document to markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Provide a file for end-to-end processing, or a checkpoint_id from a previous /convert call to skip re-parsing.
Run a published agent processor on a document. Address it with processor=<id>, optionally pinned to a version as <id>@<version>
This endpoint is used to check the health of the API, given an API key.
